decision.rationale: I recommend provisional credit of 942.84 EUR for TXN-008122, a payment on card CRD-000023 to RIVERSIDE OUTFITTERS (MER-000060). Time limit: the payment posted on 2026-08-20 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-27. That is 68 days, inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. Authorisation: AUTH-008310 shows an online payment (entry mode ECOMMERCE) where 3-D Secure was not performed, no security code was given (CVV NOT_PRESENT) and the bank's fraud flag was set. Under unauthorised-card-not-present, a payment counts as unauthorised when the card was not present, 3-D Secure was not used and the fraud flag is set. All three hold here. The credit limit does not block it: 942.84 EUR is below the 3,000.00 EUR cap for automated provisional credit in provisional-credit. The credit is exactly the posted amount, which is also what the cardholder claims.
